parameters.name: DeleteAll
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter applies only when TagKeys is not specified. Valid values:

- **true**: All tags are removed.

- **false**: Only the tags specified in the TagKeys parameter are removed.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The resource IDs. To specify multiple resource IDs, separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Only `application` is supported.

parameters.name: TagKeys
parameters.description: The tag keys. To specify multiple tag keys, separate them with commas (,).
